jobs.title: Director, Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Movable Ink scales content personalization for marketers through data-activated content generation and AI decisioning. The world’s most innovative brands rely on Movable Ink to maximize revenue, simplify workflow and boost marketing agility. Headquartered in New York City with close to 600 employees, Movable Ink serves its global client base with operations throughout North America, Central America, Europe, Australia, and Japan.  We’re looking for a Director of Data Analytics - AI Activation to bridge the gap between deployed AI models and high-impact digital marketing by spearheading our AI activation and client onboarding programs. As the Director of Data Analytics - AI Activation, you won’t just lead a world-class team of data scientist/analysts, you will architect the end-to-end program management strategy for our AI portfolio. You will orchestrate the seamless onboarding of clients onto our cutting-edge AI, design performance monitoring and diagnostic playbooks that empower our Support teams, and command the resolution of complex performance escalations. By harmonizing scalable model observability/experimentation with rigorous portfolio management, you will ensure our performance telemetry translates into scalable reporting and experimentation solutions that drive measurable success for the world’s most innovative brands. 
Responsibilities
:  

Grow, lead, and mentor a high-performing team of Data Scientist/Analysts focused on measuring and monitoring sophisticated model pipelines, including day-to-day coaching, technical mentorship, and long-term career development.
Direct program management initiatives to seamlessly coordinate the client onboarding pipeline onto our AI models.
Monitor and automate client portfolio performances, ROI and diagnostics at scale, ensuring our deployed AI models translate directly into tangible business growth. Establish and uphold rigorous analytical standards within your team.
Lead the team in designing and implementing comprehensive performance/diagnostics readout playbooks to empower the Support team in client conversations.
Manage complex performance issue escalations, driving rapid resolution by partnering closely with our Machine Learning Engineers and cross-functional teams.
Oversee the deployment of robust, commercial-grade tracking and experimentation products that redefine client expectations regarding AI transparency.

Qualifications:

7+ years of combined experience in data analytics, technical program management, and leadership, with a focus on measuring and monitoring sophisticated model pipelines.
Demonstrated experience hiring, growing, and guiding technical teams, bringing strong technical leadership skills to mentor direct reports.
Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related technical field.
Exceptional program management skills with the ability to coordinate complex client onboarding pipelines and work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, handling multiple priorities simultaneously.
Strong foundational knowledge of the team's technical stack, including proficiency in Python, expertise in SQL (GCP/BigQuery, AWS/Redshift), and advanced proficiency in Tableau.
Strategic understanding of the AI model lifecycle, from discovery and experimentation to production deployment and evaluation.
Strong background in statistical modeling and predictive analytics for evaluating recommender systems and propensity scoring.
Outstanding ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, Support teams, and cross-functional partners.
Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality solutions and robust escalation management.
Eager to continuously learn and stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and related technologies.

The base pay range for this position is $225,000-$290,000/year CAD, which can include additional bonus depending on the position ultimately offered, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. The base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

jobs.description:
Data. Discovery. Better Health.

ICES is a world-leading health research and analytics institute. With a wealth of data and analytic expertise, we create trusted evidence that has changed health policy and practice and helps ensure better health for all.

Ready to discover more with us? Join our outstanding, collaborative team where your skills, knowledge and curiosity are valued and can change the future of health care.

At ICES, we recognize what matters most to our employees. Some of the great benefits of working at ICES include:

Flexible work arrangements
Competitive Compensation
Comprehensive Benefits Program
HOOPP Pension Plan (Defined Pension)
Employee Assistance Program and Dialogue Well Being Program
Generous vacation, float and caregiver days for all employees
Education Fund and Dedicated Education Days
Holiday Closure
Perkopolis Employee Discount Program

Introduction:

ICES is seeking a Director, Indigenous Partnerships, Data and Analytic Services to join our Indigenous Partnerships, Data and Analytic Services (IPDA) department. Reporting to the Senior Director, Strategic Partnerships and Digital Services, the Director, in collaboration with ICES leadership, is responsible for the development and delivery of the work of the department at ICES. This includes the developing partnerships, guiding governance, connecting with communities, and developing mutual capacity building with First Nations, Métis, Inuit organizational and health service provider partners across urban, rural, and remote geographies

Responsibilities of the position include, but may not be limited to:

Indigenous Partnership Development:

Accountable for developing, implementing, and managing the Indigenous Partnerships, Data and Analytics (IPDA) department at ICES. This includes facilitating the assertion of representative and diverse First Nations, Inuit, and Métis approaches, perspectives, protocols, and practices to leadership at ICES.
Effectively manage all aspects of performance management for direct reports, including coaching individuals and conducting continuous evaluations to enhance team effectiveness and alignment with departmental goals.
Utilize leadership and project management skills to ensure that departmental initiatives align with ICES' strategic objectives and community needs.

Strategy Management and Operational Planning:

Manage the design and development of an effective and ongoing strategy related to Indigenous data and partnerships. This involves advancing the harmonization of ongoing ICES scientific and corporate strategies with First Nations, Inuit, and Métis requirements and protocols.
Employ analytical and strategic planning skills to assess current practices and develop actionable plans. This includes utilizing data analysis tools and stakeholder feedback to inform strategy development and ensure alignment with community needs and organizational objectives.
Work with cross-functional teams to ensure that the strategy is responsive to evolving Indigenous data sovereignty principles, leveraging collaborative skills to engage stakeholders in the process.
Oversee departmental expenses and recovery of costs by reviewing financial reports and tracking operational expenditures and ensure budget compliance.
Analyze budget requirements and make recommendations for resource allocation, ensuring that financial resources are used efficiently to support research projects and departmental initiatives.

Policy Advisory:

Advise on adapting ICES policies and processes to align with the visions, principles, and requirements of First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples across Ontario. This ensures that all organizational practices are culturally relevant and compliant with community expectations.
Utilize knowledge of Indigenous governance and policy frameworks to facilitate discussions with stakeholders, gathering insights and recommendations for policy adaptation. This involves conducting research and engaging with community leaders to ensure that ICES practices reflect Indigenous perspectives and values.
Prepare policy briefs and reports to communicate recommendations to ICES leadership, ensuring that information is clear and actionable.

Education and Capacity Building:

Educate and provide expertise to internal and external partners regarding First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples' data and data use at ICES. This includes developing training materials and conducting workshops to enhance understanding of Indigenous data sovereignty principles.
Leverage communication and presentation skills to effectively convey complex information, utilizing multimedia tools and resources to engage diverse audiences.
Oversee the development of internal and external capacity-building initiatives, collaborating with educational institutions and community organizations to strengthen partnerships and enhance data literacy.

External Representation:

Represent ICES at external meetings and share ICES’ approach to integrating Indigenous data sovereignty principles. This involves engaging with Indigenous thought leaders to seek guidance on best practices and emerging trends in Indigenous data management.
Utilize networking and relationship-building skills to establish and maintain connections with key external stakeholders, ensuring that ICES remains responsive to community needs and perspectives.
Develop proposals and oversee reporting documents for funders and stakeholders

Team Management and Development:

Manage, coach, and evaluate the team by providing regular feedback and facilitating team-building activities to promote collaboration and alignment with goals, utilizing performance management tools and techniques.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying training needs, organizing professional development opportunities, and mentoring team members to enhance their skills and career growth, ensuring access to relevant resources and training programs.
Utilize leadership and mentoring skills to enhance departmental effectiveness and individual growth, ensuring alignment with ICES' mission and values by creating an inclusive and supportive team environment.

Other:

Other duties as may be assigned within the scope of this position.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities:

Minimum Required Education, Years of Experience:

Bachelor’s Degree in related field;
At least 8 years of Indigenous community and/or research experience;
Experience working with major health system and Indigenous stakeholders and leaders within Ontario;
A minimum of 5 years management experience;
Demonstrated knowledge of Indigenous cultures and histories in Canada.

Preferred Education, Years of Experience:

Master’s degree in related field.;
Demonstrated knowledge of Indigenous cultures and histories in Canada, through personal lived experiences.

Minimum Required Position-Specific Knowledge and Technical Skills:

Understanding and experience working with principles of Indigenous data sovereignty.
Familiarity and knowledge of the diversity of First Nation, Inuit, and Métis Peoples.
Recognized leadership in First Nations, Métis, and/or Inuit communities, demonstrating a commitment to cultural competence and community engagement.
Experience working with Provincial, Territorial and/or Federal government and government agencies;
Demonstrated understanding of Indigenous research methodologies and approaches, with an asset being knowledge of quantitative Indigenous health research methodologies.
Demonstrated understanding of strategic planning and program implementation, ensuring alignment with community needs and organizational goals.
Demonstrated project management expertise, including budget and timeline management, to ensure successful delivery of initiatives.
Demonstrated understanding of the health care system, policy development, and planning in Ontario, particularly as it relates to Indigenous health.
Collaborative leadership skills, demonstrating the ability to lead effective teams toward desired outcomes.

Preferred Position-Specific Knowledge and Technical Skills:

Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.
Relationship building skills, with a proven ability to foster trust and collaboration among stakeholders.
Flexibility and adaptability to work on multiple projects simultaneously, managing competing priorities effectively.
Demonstrated strategic planning and management skills, with a focus on achieving measurable results and community impact.
Knowledge of ICES mission and goals, ensuring that partnerships align with organizational objectives.

This full-time opportunity is for an existing vacancy at ICES Central. The annual salary range for this role is $140,000 - $155,000.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Team

The Senior Director, FX Engineering will lead the strategy, delivery, modernization, and operational excellence of the Bank’s Foreign Exchange technology ecosystem. The Role

This role is accountable for the engineering delivery and operational excellence of global FX trading, pricing, risk, market connectivity, workflow, settlement, and reporting platforms across Murex and internally developed systems to ensure the FX ecosystem effectively supports business growth, client needs, regulatory requirements, and operational excellence

The role leads a global organization of engineering leaders, architects, and software engineers supporting Front Office, Market Risk, Operations, Finance, and Control Functions. jobs.title: VP of Finance & Accounting (WHL Group & Family Office)
jobs.description:
About the role
WHL Group is hiring a VP of Finance & Accounting to run the finance and accounting function for a privately held, owner-led group and its Family Office. You will own the close, consolidation, treasury, cash forecasting, FP&A, tax compliance and advisor management, and lead a lean team: the Corporate Controller and two accountants.
Our CFO has moved into a combined CFO/COO role focused on operations and growth. We need a finance leader who can take the function off her plate and run it independently. This is a junior-CFO hire with a clear path to accelerated promotion to CFO, based on performance.
About WHL Group.
WHL is a group of nine entities across Canada, the United States and Barbados, reporting in CAD, USD and BBD, with a September 30 fiscal year end. It includes operating healthcare businesses, holding and management companies, and the owner's Family Office. Books are kept in QuickBooks Online.
What you'll do
Close and reporting:
run a calendarized month-end close and multi-currency consolidation for nine entities, and deliver the monthly owner reporting package and the September 30 year end
FP&A:
lead the annual budget, rolling forecasts, KPI models and variance commentary, and partner with operating leaders on results, pricing and cost
Treasury and cash:
own banking, cash positioning, intercompany funding, FX and the rolling 13-week cash forecast
Tax and compliance:
own the compliance calendar across Canada, the US and Barbados, and lead responses to tax authority reviews with external advisors
Intercompany:
keep intercompany balances reconciled and aligned with the group's transfer pricing position
Family Office:
maintain the owner's personal holdings records, draws and funding, and coordinate with personal advisors
Controls and systems:
keep every entity audit-ready and own the QuickBooks structure, close checklists and review standards
Leadership:
lead the Corporate Controller and two accountants, and manage all external finance advisors to scope, budget and deadline

The pace.
This is a high-demand, fast-paced role with overlapping deadlines and same-day or next-day owner requests that must be right the first time. We expect you to make finance decisions yourself and bring conclusions, not questions.
What you bring
CPA (CPA Canada or US CPA) or equivalent designation
12+ years in finance and accounting, including 5+ years as VP Finance, Director of Finance, Corporate Controller or equivalent in a multi-entity group
A track record of running a finance function with little oversight and hitting every close and filing deadline
Hands-on multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation, budgeting and 13-week cash forecasting
Strong Canadian corporate and indirect tax compliance knowledge, and experience with tax authority reviews
Expert QuickBooks Online across multiple company files, and advanced Excel
Experience leading a lean, hands-on accounting team, including remote staff
The judgment and presence to be an owner's trusted finance voice, and the ambition to become CFO

Nice to have:
Family Office experience; US and Barbados or Caribbean cross-border experience; transfer pricing knowledge; owner-managed or private-equity-backed background; healthcare finance; public accounting experience.
Position details
Reports to:
CFO/COO
Direct report:
Corporate Controller
Location:
Canada or United States (remote)
Type:

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

As Director, Customer Education & Documentation, you will lead Redwood's global documentation and customer education practice and rebuild it for an AI-first operating model. You will inherit an established team in Canada and India and reshape it: what the team produces, how it produces it, and how its impact is measured. AI-assisted and agentic content production, a best-in-class docs-as-code platform, in-product guidance through Pendo, and training that shortens time-to-value for new customers and partners are the four pillars of the role.

You are a builder and a player-coach at the system level. You set the strategy, then redesign the workflows, roles, and tooling that deliver it.

Reinvent the Team for AI

Redesign the team's operating model, roles, and skills mix around AI-assisted and agentic content production, moving the team from writing and maintaining content by hand to designing, governing, and validating AI-generated content.
Define which content work is delegated to AI, which stays with human judgment, and how validation is performed. Publish standards for accuracy, review, and provenance that the team follows.
Build and run agentic pipelines for drafting, translation, release-note and change-driven updates, link and quality checks, and content-gap detection.
Reskill current team members, reset role definitions and career paths, and hire selectively for the capabilities the redesigned team requires.
Set measurable productivity and quality targets (cycle time from release to published content, coverage, accuracy, cost per asset) and report results.
Make content structured and machine-readable so that customers, partners, and AI assistants can consume Redwood documentation reliably.

Build Best-in-Class Docs as Code

Own the end-to-end documentation platform strategy: content in version control, authored in Markdown/MDX, built and published through CI/CD, reviewed through pull requests alongside product code.
Lead the migration from legacy authoring tools to a modern docs-as-code platform, including information architecture, content modeling, redirects, search, versioning, and access control.
Embed documentation in the product delivery lifecycle with engineering and Product: docs as a release gate, shared ownership, automated checks, and documentation updates triggered by code and API changes.
Raise API and developer documentation to the standard expected of a platform product, including OpenAPI-driven reference content.
Establish quality, style, localization, and accessibility standards, and instrument documentation with usage and effectiveness analytics.

Drive In-Product Guidance and Onboarding

Own the Pendo guide strategy: in-app walkthroughs, tooltips, announcements, and contextual help that move new users to first value faster and reduce support demand.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Product Operations on tagging standards, guide governance, and analytics, so guides are resilient to product change and measured against adoption outcomes.
Connect in-product guidance, documentation, and training into one learning experience, so a user reaches the right content in the right place with no hand-offs.

Deliver Training That Changes Customer and Partner Outcomes

Own the global customer education strategy and its delivery through Redwood University (Skilljar): role-based learning paths, certification, instructor-led and on-demand training, and partner and implementation-partner enablement.
Design onboarding programs for new customers and partners that measurably reduce time-to-value, ramp time, and onboarding-related support and services effort.
Use AI to scale course development, localization, personalization, and assessment, while holding a high bar for instructional quality.
Evaluate and, where the case supports it, build scalable and revenue-generating education offerings, including certification and partner programs.
Define and report education outcomes: completion, certification, adoption lift, onboarding time, support deflection, and customer and partner satisfaction.

Lead a Global, Distributed Team

Lead managers and senior individual contributors in Canada and India, with a clear operating rhythm across time zones, shared standards, and consistent quality.
Coach and develop leaders, set expectations, manage performance, and build succession.
Manage the annual plan, budget, and vendor relationships for documentation, learning, and AI tooling, and make build-versus-buy recommendations.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Marketing, and Partner teams to align content and training to the customer journey.
Present strategy, results, risks, and investment needs to senior executives.

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Technical Communication, Instructional Design, Education, Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or similar); master's degree preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in technical documentation, customer education, developer experience, technical content, or digital adoption for software products, including 5+ years leading managers and distributed teams. We weigh demonstrated outcomes over tenure; backgrounds in developer experience, documentation engineering, support knowledge management, and product-led onboarding are welcome.
Demonstrated experience leading a team through a major change in how it works, and delivering measurable gains in output, quality, or cost.
Hands-on fluency with AI in content production: you can describe specific workflows where AI generates content, what your team validates, how the tools fail, and how your approach has changed in the past six months. Experience designing or governing agentic content workflows in production is strongly preferred.
A docs-as-code platform you built or migrated to at scale (Git-based workflows, Markdown/MDX, documentation platforms such as Mintlify, CI/CD publishing, automated content checks), and a record of working with engineering to make documentation part of the release process. You can state the size of the content estate, the team, and the results.
Experience leading teams in India and North America, with proven practices for distributed collaboration and consistent quality.
Strongly preferred: experience with Pendo or an equivalent digital adoption platform, including guide design, tagging and governance, and analytics-based iteration.
Strongly preferred: experience running customer and partner training at scale, ideally on Skilljar or a comparable LMS, including certification and onboarding programs tied to adoption and time-to-value outcomes. If your background is elsewhere, show how you would build this capability or lead those who have it.
Ability to define metrics, instrument programs, and show business impact to executives.

Director, Digital Fundraising
Blue North Strategies Inc.

Help us do more good!

At Blue North Strategies, we believe great fundraising makes great things possible.
We're a fundraising agency that partners with nonprofit organizations to help them build stronger relationships with donors, grow their fundraising programs and make a greater impact in the communities they serve.
We're looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Director, Digital Fundraising
to lead our digital team, strengthen our digital fundraising capabilities and help drive the continued growth of our business.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines digital fundraising expertise with strong business acumen, strategic thinking and a passion for developing people.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Vice President, Client Experience and Consulting, the Director, Digital Fundraising will lead the strategy, growth and performance of Blue North's digital fundraising business.
You'll be responsible for developing innovative digital fundraising strategies, expanding our service offerings, delivering exceptional client results and ensuring the profitability of our digital business unit.
You'll also play an important role in bringing digital and traditional fundraising together, helping our clients create meaningful donor experiences across multiple channels.
We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to challenge the status quo, explore new opportunities and turn great ideas into measurable results.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Digital Strategy and Innovation

Develop and execute digital fundraising strategies that drive donor engagement, revenue growth and long-term client success.
Identify opportunities to expand and enhance Blue North's digital services, keeping pace with emerging technologies, industry trends and changing donor behaviours.
Collaborate with internal teams to integrate digital fundraising into broader multi-channel campaigns.
Establish best practices, processes and workflows that improve efficiency, consistency and campaign performance.
Evaluate new technologies, AI-enabled tools and digital platforms to strengthen our capabilities and client offerings.

Drive Growth and Client Results

Take ownership of the financial performance of the digital business unit, including revenue growth, profitability, forecasting and budgets.
Partner with Account Directors and fundraising strategists to identify opportunities to grow existing client programs.
Lead the digital strategy and scoping for new business proposals, RFPs and client presentations.
Oversee digital campaign performance, ensuring programs deliver measurable results and strong returns on investment.
Build Blue North's reputation as a leader in digital fundraising through thought leadership, case studies and industry engagement.

Deliver Exceptional Digital Campaigns

Oversee the strategy and execution of digital fundraising programs across email, SMS, paid advertising, websites, donation pages and other digital channels.
Drive donor acquisition, retention, reactivation and monthly giving strategies.
Use analytics, testing, segmentation and automation to continually improve campaign performance.
Establish and maintain high standards for digital creative, user experience, accessibility and campaign quality.
Work closely with internal teams to ensure projects are properly scoped, resourced and delivered on time and within budget.

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

Provide leadership, coaching and mentorship to the digital team, creating an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
Establish clear goals, expectations and performance measures that support both individual development and business objectives.
Identify opportunities to strengthen team capabilities through training, technology and improved ways of working.
Collaborate across departments to build digital knowledge and encourage innovative, integrated thinking.
Support workforce planning, recruitment and the continued development of the digital team.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in digital nonprofit marketing and fundraising, including at least three years in a people leadership role.
A demonstrated track record of growing digital fundraising revenue, delivering strong campaign results and managing significant media budgets.
Strong expertise in digital fundraising strategies, including email and SMS marketing, paid media, donor acquisition, conversion optimization and marketing automation.
Advanced experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, Mailchimp, WordPress, Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager.
Experience using data, analytics and testing to make informed decisions and continuously improve performance.
Strong financial and business acumen, including experience managing budgets, forecasting revenue and contributing to business growth.
An understanding of how digital fundraising integrates with direct mail, monthly giving and broader donor engagement strategies.
Practical experience using AI and emerging technologies to improve marketing effectiveness and efficiency.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate complex digital strategies into clear recommendations for clients and colleagues.
A collaborative leadership style and a genuine interest in coaching, developing and supporting others.

Experience working in an agency environment, familiarity with donor CRM platforms and data visualization tools, and post-secondary education in marketing or a related field would be considered assets.

Why Blue North?

At Blue North, the work we do matters.
Every day, we help organizations that are feeding people, supporting communities, advancing research and making a difference in people's lives.
We're a team of curious thinkers, problem-solvers and collaborators who care about our clients, our colleagues and the impact of our work.
We believe in taking ownership, asking better questions, being straightforward and showing up for one another.
If you're excited about leading a talented team, shaping the future of digital fundraising and helping nonprofit organizations do more good, we'd love to hear from you.

Interested in Joining Our Team?

We'd love to learn more about you!
Apply today and tell us why you'd be a great fit for Blue North Strategies.

One Team. One Redwood

Work the Problem

AI-assisted and agentic content production, a best-in-class docs-as-code platform, in-product guidance through Pendo, and training that shortens time-to-value for new customers and partners are the four pillars of the role.

Reinvent the Team for AI

Redesign the team's operating model, roles, and skills mix around AI-assisted and agentic content production, moving the team from writing and maintaining content by hand to designing, governing, and validating AI-generated content.

Establish quality, style, localization, and accessibility standards, and instrument documentation with usage and effectiveness analytics.

Connect in-product guidance, documentation, and training into one learning experience, so a user reaches the right content in the right place with no hand-offs.

Design onboarding programs for new customers and partners that measurably reduce time-to-value, ramp time, and onboarding-related support and services effort.

Evaluate and, where the case supports it, build scalable and revenue-generating education offerings, including certification and partner programs.

Present strategy, results, risks, and investment needs to senior executives.

A docs-as-code platform you built or migrated to at scale (Git-based workflows, Markdown/MDX, documentation platforms such as Mintlify, CI/CD publishing, automated content checks), and a record of working with engineering to make documentation part of the release process. Blue North Strategies Inc.

Help us do more good!

At Blue North Strategies, we believe great fundraising makes great things possible.
We're a fundraising agency that partners with nonprofit organizations to help them build stronger relationships with donors, grow their fundraising programs and make a greater impact in the communities they serve.
We're looking for an experienced and forward-thinking Director, Digital Fundraising
to lead our digital team, strengthen our digital fundraising capabilities and help drive the continued growth of our business.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines digital fundraising expertise with strong business acumen, strategic thinking and a passion for developing people.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Vice President, Client Experience and Consulting, the Director, Digital Fundraising will lead the strategy, growth and performance of Blue North's digital fundraising business.
You'll be responsible for developing innovative digital fundraising strategies, expanding our service offerings, delivering exceptional client results and ensuring the profitability of our digital business unit.
You'll also play an important role in bringing digital and traditional fundraising together, helping our clients create meaningful donor experiences across multiple channels.
We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to challenge the status quo, explore new opportunities and turn great ideas into measurable results.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead Digital Strategy and Innovation

Develop and execute digital fundraising strategies that drive donor engagement, revenue growth and long-term client success.
Identify opportunities to expand and enhance Blue North's digital services, keeping pace with emerging technologies, industry trends and changing donor behaviours.
Collaborate with internal teams to integrate digital fundraising into broader multi-channel campaigns.
Establish best practices, processes and workflows that improve efficiency, consistency and campaign performance.
Evaluate new technologies, AI-enabled tools and digital platforms to strengthen our capabilities and client offerings.

Drive Growth and Client Results

Take ownership of the financial performance of the digital business unit, including revenue growth, profitability, forecasting and budgets.
Partner with Account Directors and fundraising strategists to identify opportunities to grow existing client programs.
Lead the digital strategy and scoping for new business proposals, RFPs and client presentations.
Oversee digital campaign performance, ensuring programs deliver measurable results and strong returns on investment.
Build Blue North's reputation as a leader in digital fundraising through thought leadership, case studies and industry engagement.

Deliver Exceptional Digital Campaigns

Oversee the strategy and execution of digital fundraising programs across email, SMS, paid advertising, websites, donation pages and other digital channels.
Drive donor acquisition, retention, reactivation and monthly giving strategies.
Use analytics, testing, segmentation and automation to continually improve campaign performance.
Establish and maintain high standards for digital creative, user experience, accessibility and campaign quality.
Work closely with internal teams to ensure projects are properly scoped, resourced and delivered on time and within budget.

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

Provide leadership, coaching and mentorship to the digital team, creating an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
Establish clear goals, expectations and performance measures that support both individual development and business objectives.
Identify opportunities to strengthen team capabilities through training, technology and improved ways of working.
Collaborate across departments to build digital knowledge and encourage innovative, integrated thinking.
Support workforce planning, recruitment and the continued development of the digital team.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of progressive experience in digital nonprofit marketing and fundraising, including at least three years in a people leadership role.
A demonstrated track record of growing digital fundraising revenue, delivering strong campaign results and managing significant media budgets.
Strong expertise in digital fundraising strategies, including email and SMS marketing, paid media, donor acquisition, conversion optimization and marketing automation.
Advanced experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, Mailchimp, WordPress, Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager.
Experience using data, analytics and testing to make informed decisions and continuously improve performance.
Strong financial and business acumen, including experience managing budgets, forecasting revenue and contributing to business growth.
An understanding of how digital fundraising integrates with direct mail, monthly giving and broader donor engagement strategies.
Practical experience using AI and emerging technologies to improve marketing effectiveness and efficiency.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate complex digital strategies into clear recommendations for clients and colleagues.
A collaborative leadership style and a genuine interest in coaching, developing and supporting others.

Experience working in an agency environment, familiarity with donor CRM platforms and data visualization tools, and post-secondary education in marketing or a related field would be considered assets.

Why Blue North?

At Blue North, the work we do matters.
Every day, we help organizations that are feeding people, supporting communities, advancing research and making a difference in people's lives.
We're a team of curious thinkers, problem-solvers and collaborators who care about our clients, our colleagues and the impact of our work.
We believe in taking ownership, asking better questions, being straightforward and showing up for one another.
If you're excited about leading a talented team, shaping the future of digital fundraising and helping nonprofit organizations do more good, we'd love to hear from you.

Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

The Director, Enterprise Architecture is a strategic technology leadership role responsible for connecting business objectives, enterprise platforms, infrastructure services, cloud environments, security, networking, operations, and application development into a cohesive technology ecosystem.

This leader will serve as a cross-functional architecture authority, partnering with all technology towers to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, integrated, operationally sustainable, and aligned with the Company’s long-term technology strategy.

In addition to architecture leadership responsibilities, this role will act as a key technical orchestrator for complex, multi-disciplinary initiatives led by the PMO. The position will help align stakeholders, coordinate technical dependencies across towers, facilitate solution decisions, and ensure enterprise-wide execution alignment for strategic programs and projects.

The role requires a highly experienced technology professional with broad enterprise architecture expertise, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence technical and operational teams across the organization. This position will work closely with Cloud, Security, Network, End User Services, Application teams, and PMO leadership to drive architecture governance, modernization initiatives, integration strategies, and enterprise-wide technology standards

Key Responsibilities

Define and maintain the enterprise architecture strategy, standards, principles, and roadmap aligned with business and technology objectives.
Serve as the primary architectural advisor across all technology towers and application domains.
Drive standardization and simplification across platforms, systems, integrations, and operational processes.
Facilitate collaboration between technical towers to eliminate silos and improve technology interoperability.
Lead architecture discussions for enterprise initiatives, digital transformation programs, and modernization efforts.
Partner with application teams to align software architecture with infrastructure, security, and operational standards.
Partner closely with the PMO to support delivery of mid-to-high complexity, cross-functional technology initiatives.
Act as the technical coordination lead for multi-disciplinary projects involving multiple technology towers and business stakeholders.
Facilitate alignment sessions, technical workshops, and architecture reviews to support successful program execution.
Identify technical risks, integration gaps, resource dependencies, and architectural constraints early in the project lifecycle.
Support project governance activities by providing technical guidance, executive-level updates, and solution recommendations.
Support multi-year technology roadmap development across infrastructure and application domains.
Ensure alignment with cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and governance requirements.
Participate in major incident reviews, root cause analysis, and strategic remediation planning where architecture improvements are required.
Provide executive-level communication and technical leadership for complex initiatives and strategic programs.
Influence cross-functional teams without direct authority while fostering collaboration and accountability.
Serve as a bridge between technical delivery teams, operational teams, and project/program leadership.
Evaluate and support enterprise AI, data, and analytics initiatives to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, infrastructure, security, and operational standards.
Provide architectural guidance for modern cloud-native data and AI ecosystems, including compute, storage, networking, security, and integration requirements.

Key Deliverables

Enterprise technology roadmaps developed and maintained in alignment with business priorities and technology strategy.
Architecture standards, design principles, and governance processes documented and communicated across technology domains.
Architecture assessments and recommendations completed for strategic initiatives and major technology investments.
Cross-functional dependency assessments completed for strategic technology programs.
Technical risks, integration requirements, and architecture constraints identified and communicated during project planning and execution.
Architecture reviews conducted for mid-to-high complexity initiatives requiring multi-tower participation.
Technical decision frameworks and solution recommendations provided to support project governance and executive decision-making.

Modernization opportunities identified and prioritized across infrastructure, cloud, operations, and application environments.
Architectural recommendations developed to improve scalability, resiliency, security, and operational effectiveness.
Architectural guidance and technology recommendations provided for AI, analytics, automation, and data platform initiatives.
Evaluation frameworks developed for emerging technologies and strategic technology investments.
Enterprise architecture considerations incorporated into AI and data platform initiatives to ensure alignment with infrastructure, security, and operational requirements.

Required Experience

12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise technology environments.
5+ years in architecture, technology strategy or senior technical leadership roles.
Experience leading enterprise-scale architecture initiatives in complex, multi-team environments.
Demonstrated experience supporting large-scale, cross-functional programs and coordinating technical delivery across multiple teams.
Experience working in highly collaborative, matrixed organizations.
Experience supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, operations, and application environments.
Experience driving enterprise modernization, transformation, and integration initiatives.
Experience of engaging with executive stakeholders and business leadership teams.

Strong enterprise architecture and systems thinking capabilities.- Deep understanding of hybrid infrastructure and cloud-native architecture.
Strong knowledge of systems integration patterns and enterprise platforms.
Knowledge of IT governance, operational frameworks, and service management practices.
Strong knowledge of cloud-native AI and data platform architectures and their infrastructure dependencies.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, resiliency, scalability, and operational sustainability principles.
Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives.
Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent executive communication and presentation capabilities.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to influence teams and drive alignment without direct authority.

Lab Summary

Samsung Research America (SRA) develops next-generation technologies in software, user experience, and services for future products. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with locations across North America, we partner with industry and academia to translate research and innovation into tangible outcomes. We lead in machine intelligence by building AI that is user-centric and physically grounded—AI that understands not just what users want, but their physical context and environment.

Samsung is uniquely positioned to bring this vision to life through nearly 500 million connected devices we sell annually. Our mission is to holistically integrate AI into connected ecosystems—homes, offices, robotics, and beyond—creating a platform that scales quickly while providing deep contextual understanding and spatial awareness.

The AI Center in Toronto, Canada plays a pivotal role in developing next-generation software, user experiences, and intelligent services that enrich consumers’ lives. This lab actively contributes to the international research community through publications and presentations at major conferences.

Areas Of Research

Computer Vision
Contextual/Multi-Modal Modeling
3D Perception & Scene Understanding
Inference and Reasoning
Machine and Deep Learning
Human Computer Interaction (HCI)
Natural Language Processing

Position Summary

Samsung’s AI research team in Toronto is looking for an outstanding and highly self-motivated leader to head the lab. The candidates should have extensive expertise in deep learning, computer vision and physics-based AI.

The AI research center is a key part of Samsung’s global R&D effort and aims to have direct impact on future Samsung products reaching hundreds of millions of users globally. The candidate will work with a team of research scientists and engineers tackling real-world problems involving Samsung’s Artificial intelligence products. The candidate can also have the opportunity to publish at top-tier conferences in deep learning, computer vision, and language understanding.

Position Responsibilities

Build, manage, develop, lead, and support the AI research team, with the outcome of high-impact research insights that influence the product roadmap
Present research findings and insights both within and outside of the company
Serve as a thought partner with the executive, cross-functional, and line of business leadership teams
Be an evangelist of research practices throughout the company, influencing partner teams
Drive innovation programs within the relevant fields of Artificial Intelligence,
Serve as the external face for the AI Research Lab’s advanced technology capabilities
Drive key University technology collaboration program to build long term innovation partnerships
Lead Technology Pathfinding to understand key technology trends and impact for Samsung, to help drive growth and new business opportunities for Samsung

Required Skills

PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
10+ years of post-PhD experience leading advanced AI research.
Deep expertise in vision and multimodal AI and agentic AI (autonomous agents, reasoning, decision-making), plus strong foundations in computer vision, image/video processing, and generative AI applications.
Significant experience of publishing relevant peer-reviewed articles on artificial intelligence
Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills, and the ability to program in C/C++, Python, Java, etc.
Experience in publishing scientific papers in top quality conferences/journals (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, ACL, SIGGRAPH, CoRL, etc.)
Experience in DL library such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc. with strong hands on experience is required
Experience working with GPU, parallel programming, and Simulation environments is a plus
Experience in Android development and graphic rendering is a plus
Ability to work as a team, motivation for international collaboration, strong communication skills, self-motivated, proactive, flexible and passionate about learning
Ability to work well in a fast-paced global team environment
Strong network of relationships with entrepreneurs, VC’s industry executives, and technology thought leaders
Strong presentation skills and excellent interpersonal skills
